samples.question: The picture shows one framed panel ruled into 9 columns and 8 rows of square places; a place is either printed dark or left empty. Let every dark square fall straight down inside its own column, keeping its column, until it rests on the floor of the panel or on top of another fallen square, so each column ends as one solid stack resting on the floor and no square ever moves sideways or between columns. The nine stack heights then form an outline that most closely matches one of these five named profiles: comb, whose stacks alternate tall, short, tall, short across the panel; peak, whose stacks rise to a single tall middle column and fall away evenly on both sides; ramp, whose stacks climb steadily from an empty column at the left to a full column at the right; table, which is one flat wide plateau with a single short stack at each outer end; and valley, whose stacks are tall at both outer ends and fall to an empty middle column. Match by the smallest total difference between the nine stack heights and the profile. Which profile is it? Answer with one word.
